text: Supports importing notes from Apple Notes, Evernote, Markdown, Roam, and Workflowy formats.
quote:
We currently support imports from:

*   Apple Notes (HTML)
*   Evernote (ENEX)
*   Markdown files
*   Roam (JSON)
*   Workflowy (OPML)

text: Provides OAuth 2 authentication for API access.
quote: For authentication, we support OAuth 2. You will need to create credentials here.

text: Lets users trigger in-app actions via custom deep-link URLs.
quote: reflect://reflect?command=<command_name>&<parameter1>=<value1>&...

text: Creates backlinks showing incoming links from other notes.
quote: Backlinks are just a list of incoming links from other notes.

text: Can auto-list action items and key takeaways from meeting notes.
quote: List action-items and key takeaways from meeting notes

text: Semantic search finds relevant notes without needing exact keyword matches.
quote: Reflect’s Semantic search lets you find specific pieces of information without knowing the exact words.

text: Lets you chat with filtered notes to ask questions and extract information.
quote: you can also “chat” with those specific notes to ask questions and extract information.

text: Records edit history so notes can be reverted to any prior point in time.
quote: We continually record edits to notes which means you can see all your changes and revert a note to any point in time.

text: One-click publishing makes a note publicly available at a hard-to-guess URL.
quote: Reflect offers one-click publishing of your notes. Simply hit the publish button and your note will be publicly available behind a long hard-to-guess url.

text: Automatically syncs Kindle books, highlights, and comments as tagged, author-linked notes.
quote: Reflect can automatically sync your books, highlights, and comments from your Kindle. They will be imported into Reflect as individual notes, tagged as #book and the authors back-linked.

text: Built-in Whisper-based voice transcription with near-human accuracy.
quote: Reflect has a state of the art voice transcriber through a technology called Whisper. It has near human-level accuracy

text: Chrome and Safari extensions let you bookmark sites and clip snippets into notes.
quote: Reflect lets you quickly bookmark websites and capture snippets from across the web using our Chrome extension and Safari extension.

text: Connects Google/iCloud/Office365 calendars to pull events into daily notes.
quote:
We support connecting your Google, iCloud and Office 365 account(s) to Reflect. This lets you:

*   Pull in your calendar events, so you can easily add meetings to your daily notes.

text: Can add Trello cards or Asana tasks directly into the daily note.
quote: Add Trello cards or Asana tasks to your Daily Note

text: Notes can be filtered by date, daily-note status, backlinks, tags, or pinned status.
quote:
You can filter notes by:

*   Date created or updated
*   Daily Notes
*   Where they are backlinked to/from
*   #tags
*   Pinned notes

text: All note content is end-to-end encrypted, unreadable even by Reflect.
quote:
The contents of your notes are end-to-end  
encrypted. No one else can read them  
(not even us).

text: API supports appending data to notes and retrieving your bookmarked links.
quote: Our supports appending data to your notes, returning a list of the links you've bookmarked, and a few other things.

text: Supports OAuth PKCE so third-party clients can authenticate without embedding secret keys.
quote: We do support OAuth's PKCE extension which means you can build a client to Reflect without shipping secret keys around.

text: AI palette lets you run custom prompts on highlighted text and save them for reuse.
quote: To use it, first highlight some text, and then press cmd j (or control j on Windows). That’ll popup the AI palette.

text: Automatically creates a new daily note each day for journaling.
quote: Tools like Reflect will create a new daily note for you everyday for you to journal in.

text: Notes can be exported to open formats like HTML or Markdown.
quote: you can always export it into an open format (like HTML or Markdown).

text: iOS lock screen widget lets you start an audio memo with one tap.
quote: Our iOS has a lock screen widget that lets you start taking an audio memo with one tap.

text: Notes sync instantly across all devices.
quote: Instantly sync your notes across devices

text: Lets you capture ideas on the go, whether online or offline.
quote: Capture ideas on the go, online or offline

text: AI tools let you toggle between GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet models.
quote: Reflect's AI tools give you the option to now use either GPT-4o (the latest model from OpenAI) or Claude 3.5 Sonnet (the latest model from Anthropic). You can toggle between these in your preferences.

text: Integrates with Google Docs, Slack, email, Twitter, and Strava to add content to notes.
quote: Add Trello cards or Asana tasks to your Daily Note Add Google Docs and Slack notes to Reflect Save emails and Tweets to your notes Sync your Strava data with Reflect
